name: notebook
recipe: Spiral notebook, big marker type. A title on a yellow highlighter band with a small hand aside in the corner; section headings on coloured highlighter bands with a coloured number, or a red ribbon for a section label; pastel filled panels (a light fill of the ink and a thin solid border) instead of dashed boxes; light-blue code boxes with an optional result table beside them; tables with a coloured header row; a full-width banner callout with a lightbulb for the takeaway. Fewer, bigger blocks than a study sheet: a page holds about 8 blocks. A listicle page opens with a concept block (huge red numeral and the name) and a labelrows block; a Q&A page is qa blocks (red Q badge, question on a yellow band); a cover is two-tone marker title, ticked promises and an icon flow.
